Echeveria cante 广寒宫原文：http://crassulaceae.ch/index.php?TPL=10122&x270_id=1189
翻译：Qiuhan
转载请注明原文链接和译者。译者不懂植物学，欢迎勘误。CANTE Glass & Mendoza-Garcia, 1997
广寒宫，由Glass和Mendoza-Garcia发表于1997年
Series Gibbiflorae
Gibbiflorae系
Distribution : Mexico (Zacatecas)
分布于墨西哥的萨卡特卡斯州
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述（根据2003年的IHSP）：
Stems to 10 cm tall, 2 – 3 cm in diameter, not branching.
茎部：能长到10cm高，2-3厘米直径，不分枝。
Rosette to 40 cm in diameter
莲座：约40cm直径。
Leaves oblong-obovate, acute, to 18,5 x 7,2 cm, 6 mm thick, upper face flat to concave, thickly white-pruinose, sometimes tinged lavender, margin reddish.
叶子：椭圆形或倒卵形，窄，能长到18.5x7.2cm的长宽，6mm厚，上表面是平的或凹面的，覆有一层厚厚的白霜，有时显现淡淡的薰衣草色，叶缘发红。
Inflorescences 1 or 2, all parts pruinose, cymose-paniculate, 45 – 60 cm, ±1 cm in diameter near the base, branches ± 5, each with 4 – 12 flowers, pedicels 2 – 7 (-17) mm, to 4 mm in diameter.
花序：1-2根，部分覆有白霜，聚伞状圆锥花序，45-60cm高，基部1cm左右直径，约有5个左右分枝，每枝上4-12朵花，花梗月2-7（或17）mm长，4mm直径。
Flowers : Sepals ascending, 10 – 15 mm ; corolla 20 mm, 10 – 15 mm in diameter near the base, exterior pruinose, orange-pink, nectar scales yellowish tinged pink.
花：萼片竖直，10-15mm；花冠22mm，基部10-15mm直径，外覆白霜，粉橙色，蜜腺鳞片为淡黄色略带粉色。
Cytology : n = 27
染色体：n=27
Plants in habitat in Mexico :

ICN旧站上的相关条目（http://crassulaceae.net/echeveri ... veria-listings-c-uk，by James Low）CANTE (Glass & Mendoza, 1997), of central Mex., a long known but improperly named species, related to Ech. subrigida; name 'cante' is American Indian for "life-water"; published in CSSA Journ. Sept. 1997; now in new Series 5 (Gibbiflorae) in 2003 Lexicon; cytology: n=27(?), main stem to 10 cm tall, not branching, rosettes quite wide to 40 cm. dia, leaves heavily white frosted (pruinose) tinged lavender with reddish margin, inflorescences cymose, from 45 to 60 cm tall and pruinose, flowers orange-pink. This species was long confused with Ech. subrigida which has several minor details of difference.
=*Ech. cante [Glass & Mendoza, 1997], current. = "false Ech. subrigida of Zacatecas" (name used by some growers since 1930s).广寒宫，由Glass和Mendoza发表于1997年，分布于墨西哥中部，是一个久负盛名的品种，但一直被冠以不当的名字，比如E. subrigida（刚叶莲）；'cante'在美国印第安人之中意为"生命之水"；发表于1997年九月号的CSSA Journ.；根据2003年的Lexicon中，目前属于系列5（Gibbiflorae系）；n=27（持疑）；主干10cm高，不分枝；莲座直径能长大40cm之大，叶子上覆有厚厚的白霜，发淡紫色，叶缘发红；聚伞状花序，45-60cm高，花朵覆霜，粉橙色。这个品种常常和E. subrigida（刚叶莲）混淆，但二者之间有一些细微的不同。=*Ech. cante [Glass & Mendoza, 1997], current
=*Echeveria cante，由Glass和Mendoza发表于1997年，现用名= "false Ech. subrigida of Zacatecas" (name used by some growers since 1930s).
= Echeveria subrigida of Zacatecas，错误的名字，一些种植者自二十世纪三十年代起用这个名字。
